source_findings: Builder and auditor agree on exact four-field identities, complete results120 census, six completed stages, disjoint archives, optional unarchived native inputs, and exclusive failure-preserving output.
The existing primary descriptor is compatible without recompression; final remaining archive covers only raw members not in reused checkpoint bundles.

The final stream helper explicitly drains gzip after logical tar completion so checksum/end-of-stream failure cannot be hidden by an early tar end. This source refinement changes no earlier primary bytes or receipts.
Archive parts are stream-hashed without a second concatenated archive. Complete loose evidence avoids duplicate extraction; missing loose evidence is copied exclusively under the fresh audit output.

The reporter fixes source F and the separately published prelaunch reporting specification, remaps archived M/D input paths to the same native Git blobs, and retains all 4096/6144/48/192/992 recorded censuses.
The replay contract uses all 36 designated stable reporter outputs. Original and replay execution clocks, absolute paths and research-ledger derivatives retain separate identities.

No extra --ledger argument is planned for the first reporter execution. Its launcher will be outside its scanned completed scientific-launch directory to avoid binding an actively mutating launcher receipt.
CI retains immutable R119 action pins and Python3.12.14, sparse-checks out R120 plus workflow metadata, and scopes the no-lazy-fetch guard after checkout.
Original economic evaluator, campaign, acquisition, entropy, models and competitive timings are not rerun by this audit/CI design.
